ko.title: 한 명의 장군, 한 번의 이양: 하마스의 무장 해제를 위한 쿠슈너 계획의 내막

segments.src: ## A New Road Map Takes Shape
segments.tr: ## 새로운 로드맵의 구체화

segments.src: According to people familiar with the discussions, senior White House adviser Jared Kushner recently held a rare face-to-face meeting with Hamas representatives in Egypt before traveling directly to Jerusalem to brief Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on a revised framework for ending the group's role as an armed force in Gaza.
segments.tr: 논의에 정통한 소식통들에 따르면, 재러드 쿠슈너 백악관 선임고문은 최근 이집트에서 하마스 대표단과 드문 대면 회의를 가진 후 곧바로 예루살렘으로 이동해 베냐민 네타냐후 이스라엘 총리에게 가자지구에서 하마스의 무장 세력으로서의 역할을 종식하기 위한 수정된 프레임워크를 설명했습니다.

segments.src: The plan, still described as a work in progress, centers on a staged handover of weapons rather than a one-time surrender.
segments.tr: 아직 진행 중인 작업으로 묘사되는 이 계획은 일회성 항복보다는 단계적 무기 이양에 초점을 맞추고 있습니다.

segments.src: Under the proposed mechanism:
segments.tr: 제안된 메커니즘에 따르면:

segments.src: - Hamas fighters would turn over heavy and mid-tier weapons to a body of Palestinian technocrats — administrators without formal ties to Hamas's military wing.
segments.tr: - 하마스 대원들은 중화기 및 중거리 무기를 하마스 군사 조직과 공식적인 연계가 없는 행정가들로 구성된 팔레스타인 테크노크라트(기술관료) 기구에 넘기게 됩니다.

segments.src: - Those technocrats would then transfer the arms to an international stabilization force.
segments.tr: - 그 후 해당 테크노크라트들은 이 무기들을 국제 안정화군에 이전하게 됩니다.

segments.src: - The process would be overseen and verified by a designated American general, whose role is meant to reassure both Israeli officials and Gaza's population that the handover is being independently monitored.
segments.tr: - 이 과정은 지정된 미군 장군의 감독과 검증을 받게 되며, 이 장군의 역할은 이양 과정이 독립적으로 모니터링되고 있음을 이스라엘 당국과 가자지구 주민 모두에게 안심시키는 것입니다.

segments.src: Sources briefed on the talks say the design is meant to give Hamas a face-saving off-ramp while giving Israel and international partners a verifiable chain of custody for the weapons — addressing a core sticking point that has stalled previous ceasefire and disarmament proposals.
segments.tr: 회담에 대한 브리핑을 받은 소식통들은 이번 구상이 하마스에게는 체면을 살릴 수 있는 퇴로를 제공하는 동시에, 이스라엘과 국제 파트너들에게는 무기에 대한 검증 가능한 관리 체인을 제공함으로써 이전의 휴전 및 무장 해제 제안들을 좌절시켰던 핵심 쟁점을 해결하고자 한 것이라고 말했습니다.

segments.src: ## Netanyahu's Conditional Backing
segments.tr: ## 네타냐후의 조건부 지지

segments.src: Reports indicate Netanyahu has signaled support for the handover mechanism itself, viewing third-party verification and an American military figure's involvement as a credible safeguard.
segments.tr: 보도에 따르면 네타냐후 총리는 제3자 검증과 미군 인사의 개입을 신뢰할 수 있는 안전장치로 여기며 이양 메커니즘 자체에 대해 지지 의사를 밝혔습니다.

segments.src: However, he is said to be maintaining a firm position on troop posture: Israeli forces would not withdraw from their current positions in Gaza until disarmament is confirmed as complete, not merely underway.
segments.tr: 그러나 그는 병력 태세에 대해 확고한 입장을 유지하고 있는 것으로 알려졌습니다. 즉, 무장 해제가 진행 중인 수준이 아니라 완전히 완료된 것으로 확인될 때까지 이스라엘군은 가자지구 내 현재 위치에서 철수하지 않을 것이라는 입장입니다.

segments.src: That stance has left open questions about sequencing.
segments.tr: 이러한 입장은 순서에 대한 의문을 남겨두고 있습니다.

segments.src: Officials involved in the talks reportedly acknowledge that tying full withdrawal to full disarmament could stretch the timeline considerably, since verifying that Hamas has surrendered its entire arsenal — rather than a portion of it — is logistically difficult in a territory where weapons caches are dispersed and often hidden.
segments.tr: 회담에 관여한 관계자들은 전면적인 철수를 완전한 무장 해제와 연계할 경우 일정이 상당히 늘어날 수 있음을 인정하는 것으로 전해졌습니다. 무기 은닉처가 분산되어 있고 숨겨져 있는 경우가 많은 지역에서 하마스가 무기고의 일부가 아닌 전체를 포기했는지 검증하는 것은 물류상 어렵기 때문입니다.

segments.src: ## Reconstruction and Governance Left Waiting
segments.tr: ## 뒷전으로 밀려난 재건과 통치

segments.src: The disagreement over timing has broader consequences.
segments.tr: 시기를 둘러싼 이견은 더 광범위한 결과를 낳고 있습니다.

segments.src: Plans for rebuilding Gaza's shattered infrastructure and establishing a postwar governing authority reportedly remain on hold pending clarity on the security track.
segments.tr: 가자지구의 파괴된 인프라를 재건하고 전후 통치 기구를 수립하기 위한 계획은 안보 트랙에 대한 명확성이 확보될 때까지 보류 상태인 것으로 전해졌습니다.

segments.src: International donors and agencies said to be involved in reconstruction planning are described as reluctant to commit resources without a clearer picture of who will govern Gaza and under what security guarantees.
segments.tr: 재건 계획에 참여하고 있는 것으로 알려진 국제 기부자와 기관들은 가자지구를 누가 통치할 것인지, 그리고 어떤 안보 보장 하에 이루어질 것인지에 대한 명확한 그림이 없이는 자원을 투입하기를 꺼리는 것으로 묘사되고 있습니다.

segments.src: Analysts who have followed the negotiations note that this is not the first attempt to separate Hamas's political function from its military capability, but the addition of a named American oversight figure and a Palestinian technocratic intermediary is being described as a notable shift from earlier proposals that relied more heavily on Israeli or purely international enforcement.
segments.tr: 협상을 주시해온 분석가들은 이번이 하마스의 정치적 기능과 군사적 역량을 분리하려는 첫 시도는 아니지만, 미국인 감시 인사의 지명과 팔레스타인 테크노크라트 중재자의 도입은 이스라엘이나 순전히 국제적인 집행에 더 많이 의존했던 이전의 제안들에서 눈에 띄게 전환된 것으로 평가하고 있습니다.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 향후 전망

segments.src: People close to the process caution that no timeline has been finalized and that both the composition of the international force and the identity of the American general remain under discussion.
segments.tr: 과정에 정통한 사람들은 확정된 일정이 없으며 국제 부대의 구성과 미군 장군의 신원 모두 여전히 논의 중이라고 경고합니다.

segments.src: Kushner is expected to continue shuttling between regional capitals in the coming weeks as mediators try to convert the framework into a formal agreement.
segments.tr: 중재자들이 이번 프레임워크를 공식적인 합의로 이끌어내기 위해 노력함에 따라 쿠슈너는 다가오는 몇 주 동안 지역 수도들을 계속 오갈 것으로 예상됩니다.

segments.src: For now, the plan represents a potential bridge between two positions that have long seemed incompatible: Hamas's reluctance to disarm without guarantees, and Israel's insistence on verified disarmament before any troop drawdown.
segments.tr: 현재로서는 이 계획이 오랫동안 양립할 수 없어 보였던 두 가지 입장, 즉 보장 없이는 무장 해제를 꺼리는 하마스의 태도와 병력 철수 전에 검증된 무장 해제를 고집하는 이스라엘의 입장을 잇는 잠재적인 가교 역할을 하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Whether that bridge holds may determine how quickly Gaza's reconstruction — and its political future — can move forward.
segments.tr: 그 가교가 유지될 수 있을지는 가자지구의 재건과 정치적 미래가 얼마나 빨리 진전될 수 있는지를 결정할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: *This article is based on reporting from officials and people familiar with the ongoing negotiations.
segments.tr: *이 기사는 진행 중인 협상에 정통한 관계자들과 당국자들의 보도를 바탕으로 작성되었습니다.

segments.src: Details of the plan may change as talks continue.*
segments.tr: 협상이 계속됨에 따라 계획의 세부 사항은 변경될 수 있습니다.*

zh.title: 一位将军，一次移交：库什纳促使哈马斯解除武装计划内幕

segments.src: ## A New Road Map Takes Shape
segments.tr: ## 新路线图初现雏形

segments.src: According to people familiar with the discussions, senior White House adviser Jared Kushner recently held a rare face-to-face meeting with Hamas representatives in Egypt before traveling directly to Jerusalem to brief Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on a revised framework for ending the group's role as an armed force in Gaza.
segments.tr: 据知情人士透露，白宫高级顾问贾里德·库什纳（Jared Kushner）最近在埃及与哈马斯代表举行了一次罕见的面对面会晤，随后直接前往耶路撒冷，向以色列总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡（Benjamin Netanyahu）通报了一项旨在结束该组织作为加沙武装力量角色的修订框架。

segments.src: The plan, still described as a work in progress, centers on a staged handover of weapons rather than a one-time surrender.
segments.tr: 该计划目前仍被描述为正在进行中的工作，其核心是分阶段移交武器，而非一次性投降。

segments.src: Under the proposed mechanism:
segments.tr: 根据拟议的机制：

segments.src: - Hamas fighters would turn over heavy and mid-tier weapons to a body of Palestinian technocrats — administrators without formal ties to Hamas's military wing.
segments.tr: - 哈马斯武装人员将重型和中型武器移交给一个由巴勒斯坦技术官僚组成的机构——这些行政人员与哈马斯的军事派别没有正式联系。

segments.src: - Those technocrats would then transfer the arms to an international stabilization force.
segments.tr: - 这些技术官僚随后将把武器移交给一支国际稳定部队。

segments.src: - The process would be overseen and verified by a designated American general, whose role is meant to reassure both Israeli officials and Gaza's population that the handover is being independently monitored.
segments.tr: - 该过程将由一名指定的美国将军监督和核实，其角色旨在让以色列官员和加沙民众相信移交工作正受到独立监控。

segments.src: Sources briefed on the talks say the design is meant to give Hamas a face-saving off-ramp while giving Israel and international partners a verifiable chain of custody for the weapons — addressing a core sticking point that has stalled previous ceasefire and disarmament proposals.
segments.tr: 听取了会谈简报的消息人士称，该设计旨在为哈马斯提供一个保全面子的退路，同时为以色列和国际伙伴提供可核实的武器监管链——解决了此前停火和解除武装提案中阻碍进展的核心症结。

segments.src: ## Netanyahu's Conditional Backing
segments.tr: ## 内塔尼亚胡的有条件支持

segments.src: Reports indicate Netanyahu has signaled support for the handover mechanism itself, viewing third-party verification and an American military figure's involvement as a credible safeguard.
segments.tr: 有报道称，内塔尼亚胡已对移交机制本身表示支持，认为第三方核实和美国军事人物的参与是可靠的保障。

segments.src: However, he is said to be maintaining a firm position on troop posture: Israeli forces would not withdraw from their current positions in Gaza until disarmament is confirmed as complete, not merely underway.
segments.tr: 然而，据称他在部队态势上保持坚定立场：在确认解除武装已完成（而不仅仅是正在进行）之前，以色列军队不会从目前在加沙的阵地撤出。

segments.src: That stance has left open questions about sequencing.
segments.tr: 这一立场在顺序问题上留下了悬念。

segments.src: Officials involved in the talks reportedly acknowledge that tying full withdrawal to full disarmament could stretch the timeline considerably, since verifying that Hamas has surrendered its entire arsenal — rather than a portion of it — is logistically difficult in a territory where weapons caches are dispersed and often hidden.
segments.tr: 据报道，参与会谈的官员承认，将全面撤军与全面解除武装挂钩可能会大大拉长时间表，因为在武器库分散且往往隐藏的地区，核实哈马斯是否已上缴其全部（而非部分）军火在后勤上十分困难。

segments.src: ## Reconstruction and Governance Left Waiting
segments.tr: ## 重建与治理工作仍处于等待状态

segments.src: The disagreement over timing has broader consequences.
segments.tr: 关于时间安排的分歧产生了更广泛的后果。

segments.src: Plans for rebuilding Gaza's shattered infrastructure and establishing a postwar governing authority reportedly remain on hold pending clarity on the security track.
segments.tr: 据报道，重建加沙破碎基础设施和建立战后管理机构的计划在安全轨道明确之前仍处于搁置状态。

segments.src: International donors and agencies said to be involved in reconstruction planning are described as reluctant to commit resources without a clearer picture of who will govern Gaza and under what security guarantees.
segments.tr: 据称参与重建规划的国际捐助者和机构表示，在没有更明确的关于谁将治理加沙以及在何种安全保障下治理的图景之前，他们不愿投入资源。

segments.src: Analysts who have followed the negotiations note that this is not the first attempt to separate Hamas's political function from its military capability, but the addition of a named American oversight figure and a Palestinian technocratic intermediary is being described as a notable shift from earlier proposals that relied more heavily on Israeli or purely international enforcement.
segments.tr: 关注谈判的分析人士指出，这并非首次尝试将哈马斯的政治职能与其军事能力分离开来，但增加一名指定的美国监督人物和一名巴勒斯坦技术官僚中间人，被描述为与此前更依赖以色列或纯粹国际执行的提案相比，是一个显著的转变。

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 接下来会发生什么

segments.src: People close to the process caution that no timeline has been finalized and that both the composition of the international force and the identity of the American general remain under discussion.
segments.tr: 接近该进程的人士提醒说，目前尚未确定时间表，国际部队的组成和美国将军的人选仍在讨论中。

segments.src: Kushner is expected to continue shuttling between regional capitals in the coming weeks as mediators try to convert the framework into a formal agreement.
segments.tr: 预计库什纳将在未来几周继续在地区各国首都之间穿梭，调解人正试图将该框架转化为正式协议。

segments.src: For now, the plan represents a potential bridge between two positions that have long seemed incompatible: Hamas's reluctance to disarm without guarantees, and Israel's insistence on verified disarmament before any troop drawdown.
segments.tr: 目前，该计划代表了长期以来似乎不相容的两个立场之间的潜在桥梁：哈马斯在没有保障的情况下不愿解除武装，以及以色列坚持在任何撤军前必须进行核实的解除武装。

segments.src: Whether that bridge holds may determine how quickly Gaza's reconstruction — and its political future — can move forward.
segments.tr: 这座桥梁能否稳固，可能决定了加沙的重建及其政治未来能多快向前推进。

segments.src: *This article is based on reporting from officials and people familiar with the ongoing negotiations.
segments.tr: *本文基于官员和熟悉正在进行的谈判的人士的报道。

segments.src: Details of the plan may change as talks continue.*
segments.tr: 随着会谈的继续，计划细节可能会发生变化。*

hi.title: एक जनरल, एक हैंडओवर: हमास को निशस्त्र करने की कुशनर की योजना के अंदर की बात

segments.src: ## A New Road Map Takes Shape
segments.tr: ## एक नया रोड मैप आकार ले रहा है

segments.src: According to people familiar with the discussions, senior White House adviser Jared Kushner recently held a rare face-to-face meeting with Hamas representatives in Egypt before traveling directly to Jerusalem to brief Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on a revised framework for ending the group's role as an armed force in Gaza.
segments.tr: चर्चाओं से परिचित लोगों के अनुसार, व्हाइट हाउस के वरिष्ठ सलाहकार जेरेड कुशनर ने हाल ही में मिस्र में हमास के प्रतिनिधियों के साथ एक दुर्लभ आमने-सामने की बैठक की, जिसके बाद वे सीधे यरुशलम गए ताकि इजरायली प्रधानमंत्री बेंजामिन नेतन्याहू को गाजा में एक सशस्त्र बल के रूप में समूह की भूमिका को समाप्त करने के लिए एक संशोधित ढांचे की जानकारी दे सकें।

segments.src: The plan, still described as a work in progress, centers on a staged handover of weapons rather than a one-time surrender.
segments.tr: यह योजना, जिसे अभी भी एक प्रगतिशील कार्य के रूप में वर्णित किया गया है, एकमुश्त आत्मसमर्पण के बजाय हथियारों के चरणबद्ध हैंडओवर पर केंद्रित है।

segments.src: Under the proposed mechanism:
segments.tr: प्रस्तावित तंत्र के तहत:

segments.src: - Hamas fighters would turn over heavy and mid-tier weapons to a body of Palestinian technocrats — administrators without formal ties to Hamas's military wing.
segments.tr: - हमास के लड़ाके भारी और मध्यम स्तर के हथियार फिलिस्तीनी टेक्नोक्रेट्स (तकनीकी विशेषज्ञों) के एक निकाय को सौंपेंगे — ऐसे प्रशासक जिनका हमास की सैन्य शाखा से कोई औपचारिक संबंध नहीं है।

segments.src: - Those technocrats would then transfer the arms to an international stabilization force.
segments.tr: - वे टेक्नोक्रेट फिर उन हथियारों को एक अंतरराष्ट्रीय स्थिरीकरण बल को हस्तांतरित करेंगे।

segments.src: - The process would be overseen and verified by a designated American general, whose role is meant to reassure both Israeli officials and Gaza's population that the handover is being independently monitored.
segments.tr: - इस प्रक्रिया की निगरानी और सत्यापन एक नामित अमेरिकी जनरल द्वारा किया जाएगा, जिनकी भूमिका इजरायली अधिकारियों और गाजा की आबादी दोनों को आश्वस्त करना है कि हैंडओवर की स्वतंत्र रूप से निगरानी की जा रही है।

segments.src: Sources briefed on the talks say the design is meant to give Hamas a face-saving off-ramp while giving Israel and international partners a verifiable chain of custody for the weapons — addressing a core sticking point that has stalled previous ceasefire and disarmament proposals.
segments.tr: वार्ता की जानकारी रखने वाले सूत्रों का कहना है कि इस डिजाइन का उद्देश्य हमास को सम्मानजनक तरीके से बाहर निकलने का रास्ता देना है, जबकि इजरायल और अंतरराष्ट्रीय भागीदारों को हथियारों की कस्टडी की एक सत्यापन योग्य श्रृंखला प्रदान करना है — जो एक मुख्य अड़चन को दूर करता है जिसने पिछले युद्धविराम और निरस्त्रीकरण प्रस्तावों को रोक रखा था।

segments.src: ## Netanyahu's Conditional Backing
segments.tr: ## नेतन्याहू का सशर्त समर्थन

segments.src: Reports indicate Netanyahu has signaled support for the handover mechanism itself, viewing third-party verification and an American military figure's involvement as a credible safeguard.
segments.tr: रिपोर्टों से संकेत मिलता है कि नेतन्याहू ने हैंडओवर तंत्र का समर्थन करने का संकेत दिया है, और वे तीसरे पक्ष के सत्यापन तथा एक अमेरिकी सैन्य अधिकारी की भागीदारी को एक विश्वसनीय सुरक्षा उपाय के रूप में देखते हैं।

segments.src: However, he is said to be maintaining a firm position on troop posture: Israeli forces would not withdraw from their current positions in Gaza until disarmament is confirmed as complete, not merely underway.
segments.tr: हालांकि, कहा जाता है कि वे सैनिकों की स्थिति पर एक कड़ा रुख अपनाए हुए हैं: इजरायली सेना गाजा में अपनी वर्तमान स्थिति से तब तक पीछे नहीं हटेगी जब तक कि निरस्त्रीकरण के पूर्ण होने की पुष्टि नहीं हो जाती, न कि केवल इसके शुरू होने की।

segments.src: That stance has left open questions about sequencing.
segments.tr: इस रुख ने अनुक्रमण (क्रम निर्धारण) को लेकर सवाल खड़े कर दिए हैं।

segments.src: Officials involved in the talks reportedly acknowledge that tying full withdrawal to full disarmament could stretch the timeline considerably, since verifying that Hamas has surrendered its entire arsenal — rather than a portion of it — is logistically difficult in a territory where weapons caches are dispersed and often hidden.
segments.tr: वार्ता में शामिल अधिकारियों ने कथित तौर पर स्वीकार किया है कि पूर्ण वापसी को पूर्ण निरस्त्रीकरण से जोड़ने से समयसीमा काफी बढ़ सकती है, क्योंकि यह सत्यापित करना कि हमास ने अपने पूरे शस्त्रागार को सौंप दिया है — न कि केवल उसके एक हिस्से को — एक ऐसे क्षेत्र में तार्किक रूप से कठिन है जहां हथियारों के जखीरे बिखरे हुए हैं और अक्सर छिपे हुए हैं।

segments.src: ## Reconstruction and Governance Left Waiting
segments.tr: ## पुनर्निर्माण और शासन को इंतजार करना पड़ा

segments.src: The disagreement over timing has broader consequences.
segments.tr: समय को लेकर असहमति के व्यापक परिणाम हैं।

segments.src: Plans for rebuilding Gaza's shattered infrastructure and establishing a postwar governing authority reportedly remain on hold pending clarity on the security track.
segments.tr: गाजा के तबाह हो चुके बुनियादी ढांचे के पुनर्निर्माण और युद्ध के बाद एक शासी प्राधिकरण स्थापित करने की योजनाएं कथित तौर पर सुरक्षा ट्रैक पर स्पष्टता आने तक रुकी हुई हैं।

segments.src: International donors and agencies said to be involved in reconstruction planning are described as reluctant to commit resources without a clearer picture of who will govern Gaza and under what security guarantees.
segments.tr: पुनर्निर्माण योजना में शामिल बताए जाने वाले अंतरराष्ट्रीय दाता और एजेंसियां इस बात की स्पष्ट तस्वीर के बिना संसाधन लगाने में संकोच कर रही हैं कि गाजा पर कौन शासन करेगा और किन सुरक्षा गारंटियों के तहत।

segments.src: Analysts who have followed the negotiations note that this is not the first attempt to separate Hamas's political function from its military capability, but the addition of a named American oversight figure and a Palestinian technocratic intermediary is being described as a notable shift from earlier proposals that relied more heavily on Israeli or purely international enforcement.
segments.tr: वार्ता पर नजर रखने वाले विश्लेषकों का कहना है कि हमास के राजनीतिक कार्य को उसकी सैन्य क्षमता से अलग करने का यह पहला प्रयास नहीं है, लेकिन एक नामित अमेरिकी निगरानी अधिकारी और एक फिलिस्तीनी तकनीकी मध्यस्थ को शामिल करना पहले के उन प्रस्तावों से एक उल्लेखनीय बदलाव के रूप में वर्णित किया जा रहा है जो इजरायली या विशुद्ध रूप से अंतरराष्ट्रीय प्रवर्तन पर अधिक निर्भर थे।

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## आगे क्या होगा

segments.src: People close to the process caution that no timeline has been finalized and that both the composition of the international force and the identity of the American general remain under discussion.
segments.tr: इस प्रक्रिया के करीबी लोग आगाह करते हैं कि कोई समयसीमा तय नहीं की गई है और अंतरराष्ट्रीय बल की संरचना तथा अमेरिकी जनरल की पहचान दोनों पर चर्चा जारी है।

segments.src: Kushner is expected to continue shuttling between regional capitals in the coming weeks as mediators try to convert the framework into a formal agreement.
segments.tr: कुशनर द्वारा आने वाले हफ्तों में क्षेत्रीय राजधानियों के बीच यात्रा जारी रखने की उम्मीद है क्योंकि मध्यस्थ इस ढांचे को एक औपचारिक समझौते में बदलने की कोशिश कर रहे हैं।

segments.src: For now, the plan represents a potential bridge between two positions that have long seemed incompatible: Hamas's reluctance to disarm without guarantees, and Israel's insistence on verified disarmament before any troop drawdown.
segments.tr: फिलहाल, यह योजना दो ऐसे रुख के बीच एक संभावित पुल का प्रतिनिधित्व करती है जो लंबे समय से असंगत लग रहे थे: बिना गारंटी के हमास की निशस्त्र होने की अनिच्छा, और किसी भी सैनिक की वापसी से पहले सत्यापित निरस्त्रीकरण पर इजरायल का जोर।

segments.src: Whether that bridge holds may determine how quickly Gaza's reconstruction — and its political future — can move forward.
segments.tr: क्या वह पुल टिक पाता है, यह तय कर सकता है कि गाजा का पुनर्निर्माण — और उसका राजनीतिक भविष्य — कितनी तेजी से आगे बढ़ सकता है।

segments.src: *This article is based on reporting from officials and people familiar with the ongoing negotiations.
segments.tr: *यह लेख अधिकारियों और चल रही वार्ताओं से परिचित लोगों की रिपोर्टिंग पर आधारित है।

segments.src: Details of the plan may change as talks continue.*
segments.tr: वार्ता जारी रहने के साथ योजना के विवरण बदल सकते हैं।*

es.title: Un General, una Entrega: Detrás del Plan de Kushner para Lograr que Hamás se Desarme

segments.src: ## A New Road Map Takes Shape
segments.tr: ## Toma Forma una Nueva Hoja de Ruta

segments.src: According to people familiar with the discussions, senior White House adviser Jared Kushner recently held a rare face-to-face meeting with Hamas representatives in Egypt before traveling directly to Jerusalem to brief Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on a revised framework for ending the group's role as an armed force in Gaza.
segments.tr: Según personas familiarizadas con las discusiones, el alto asesor de la Casa Blanca, Jared Kushner, mantuvo recientemente una inusual reunión cara a cara con representantes de Hamás en Egipto antes de viajar directamente a Jerusalén para informar al primer ministro israelí, Benjamín Netanyahu, sobre un marco revisado para poner fin al papel del grupo como fuerza armada en Gaza.

segments.src: The plan, still described as a work in progress, centers on a staged handover of weapons rather than a one-time surrender.
segments.tr: El plan, que aún se describe como un trabajo en proceso, se centra en una entrega escalonada de armas en lugar de una rendición única.

segments.src: Under the proposed mechanism:
segments.tr: Bajo el mecanismo propuesto:

segments.src: - Hamas fighters would turn over heavy and mid-tier weapons to a body of Palestinian technocrats — administrators without formal ties to Hamas's military wing.
segments.tr: - Los combatientes de Hamás entregarían las armas pesadas y de mediano calibre a un organismo de tecnócratas palestinos —administradores sin vínculos formales con el ala militar de Hamás—.

segments.src: - Those technocrats would then transfer the arms to an international stabilization force.
segments.tr: - Esos tecnócratas transferirían luego las armas a una fuerza de estabilización internacional.

segments.src: - The process would be overseen and verified by a designated American general, whose role is meant to reassure both Israeli officials and Gaza's population that the handover is being independently monitored.
segments.tr: - El proceso sería supervisado y verificado por un general estadounidense designado, cuyo papel pretende asegurar tanto a los funcionarios israelíes como a la población de Gaza que la entrega está siendo monitoreada de forma independiente.

segments.src: Sources briefed on the talks say the design is meant to give Hamas a face-saving off-ramp while giving Israel and international partners a verifiable chain of custody for the weapons — addressing a core sticking point that has stalled previous ceasefire and disarmament proposals.
segments.tr: Fuentes informadas sobre las conversaciones afirman que el diseño pretende ofrecer a Hamás una salida honrosa mientras se proporciona a Israel y a los socios internacionales una cadena de custodia verificable para las armas, abordando un punto de fricción central que ha estancado propuestas anteriores de alto el fuego y desarme.

segments.src: ## Netanyahu's Conditional Backing
segments.tr: ## El Apoyo Condicional de Netanyahu

segments.src: Reports indicate Netanyahu has signaled support for the handover mechanism itself, viewing third-party verification and an American military figure's involvement as a credible safeguard.
segments.tr: Los informes indican que Netanyahu ha mostrado su apoyo al mecanismo de entrega en sí, considerando la verificación de terceros y la participación de una figura militar estadounidense como una salvaguarda creíble.

segments.src: However, he is said to be maintaining a firm position on troop posture: Israeli forces would not withdraw from their current positions in Gaza until disarmament is confirmed as complete, not merely underway.
segments.tr: Sin embargo, se dice que mantiene una postura firme sobre la disposición de las tropas: las fuerzas israelíes no se retirarían de sus posiciones actuales en Gaza hasta que se confirme que el desarme está completo, y no meramente en curso.

segments.src: That stance has left open questions about sequencing.
segments.tr: Esa postura ha dejado abiertas dudas sobre la secuencia.

segments.src: Officials involved in the talks reportedly acknowledge that tying full withdrawal to full disarmament could stretch the timeline considerably, since verifying that Hamas has surrendered its entire arsenal — rather than a portion of it — is logistically difficult in a territory where weapons caches are dispersed and often hidden.
segments.tr: Funcionarios involucrados en las conversaciones habrían reconocido que vincular la retirada total al desarme completo podría alargar considerablemente el cronograma, ya que verificar que Hamás ha entregado todo su arsenal —en lugar de una parte de este— es logísticamente difícil en un territorio donde los escondites de armas están dispersos y a menudo ocultos.

segments.src: ## Reconstruction and Governance Left Waiting
segments.tr: ## Reconstrucción y Gobernanza en Espera

segments.src: The disagreement over timing has broader consequences.
segments.tr: El desacuerdo sobre los tiempos tiene consecuencias más amplias.

segments.src: Plans for rebuilding Gaza's shattered infrastructure and establishing a postwar governing authority reportedly remain on hold pending clarity on the security track.
segments.tr: Los planes para reconstruir la devastada infraestructura de Gaza y establecer una autoridad de gobernanza de posguerra supuestamente permanecen en pausa a la espera de claridad en la vía de seguridad.

segments.src: International donors and agencies said to be involved in reconstruction planning are described as reluctant to commit resources without a clearer picture of who will govern Gaza and under what security guarantees.
segments.tr: Se dice que los donantes y agencias internacionales involucrados en la planificación de la reconstrucción muestran renuencia a comprometer recursos sin un panorama más claro sobre quién gobernará Gaza y bajo qué garantías de seguridad.

segments.src: Analysts who have followed the negotiations note that this is not the first attempt to separate Hamas's political function from its military capability, but the addition of a named American oversight figure and a Palestinian technocratic intermediary is being described as a notable shift from earlier proposals that relied more heavily on Israeli or purely international enforcement.
segments.tr: Los analistas que han seguido las negociaciones señalan que este no es el primer intento de separar la función política de Hamás de su capacidad militar, pero la incorporación de una figura de supervisión estadounidense nombrada y un intermediario tecnócrata palestino se describe como un cambio notable respecto a propuestas anteriores que dependían en mayor medida de la imposición israelí o puramente internacional.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Qué Sigue

segments.src: People close to the process caution that no timeline has been finalized and that both the composition of the international force and the identity of the American general remain under discussion.
segments.tr: Personas cercanas al proceso advierten que no se ha finalizado ningún cronograma y que tanto la composición de la fuerza internacional como la identidad del general estadounidense siguen bajo discusión.

segments.src: Kushner is expected to continue shuttling between regional capitals in the coming weeks as mediators try to convert the framework into a formal agreement.
segments.tr: Se espera que Kushner continúe viajando entre capitales regionales en las próximas semanas mientras los mediadores intentan convertir el marco en un acuerdo formal.

segments.src: For now, the plan represents a potential bridge between two positions that have long seemed incompatible: Hamas's reluctance to disarm without guarantees, and Israel's insistence on verified disarmament before any troop drawdown.
segments.tr: Por ahora, el plan representa un posible puente entre dos posturas que durante mucho tiempo han parecido incompatibles: la renuencia de Hamás a desarmarse sin garantías y la insistencia de Israel en un desarme verificado antes de cualquier reducción de tropas.

segments.src: Whether that bridge holds may determine how quickly Gaza's reconstruction — and its political future — can move forward.
segments.tr: Si ese puente se sostiene o no, podría determinar qué tan rápido puede avanzar la reconstrucción de Gaza y su futuro político.

segments.tr: Los detalles del plan pueden cambiar a medida que continúen las conversaciones.*

segments.tr: يشير المحللون الذين تابعوا المفاوضات إلى أن هذه ليست المحاولة الأولى لفصل وظيفة حماس السياسية عن قدرتها العسكرية، ولكن إضافة شخصية إشرافية أمريكية مسماة ووسيط تكنوقراط فلسطيني يوصف بأنه تحول ملحوظ عن المقترحات السابقة التي كانت تعتمد بشكل أكبر على التنفيذ الإسرائيلي أو الدولي الخالص.

segments.src: Kushner is expected to continue shuttling between regional capitals in the coming weeks as mediators try to convert the framework into a formal agreement.

segments.src: For now, the plan represents a potential bridge between two positions that have long seemed incompatible: Hamas's reluctance to disarm without guarantees, and Israel's insistence on verified disarmament before any troop drawdown.

fr.title: Un général, un transfert : dans les coulisses du plan de Kushner pour obtenir le désarmement du Hamas

segments.src: ## A New Road Map Takes Shape
segments.tr: ## Une nouvelle feuille de route se dessine

segments.src: According to people familiar with the discussions, senior White House adviser Jared Kushner recently held a rare face-to-face meeting with Hamas representatives in Egypt before traveling directly to Jerusalem to brief Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on a revised framework for ending the group's role as an armed force in Gaza.
segments.tr: Selon des personnes proches des discussions, le conseiller principal de la Maison-Blanche, Jared Kushner, a récemment tenu une rare réunion en face-à-face avec des représentants du Hamas en Égypte avant de se rendre directement à Jérusalem pour informer le Premier ministre israélien Benjamin Netanyahu d'un cadre révisé visant à mettre fin au rôle du groupe en tant que force armée à Gaza.

segments.src: The plan, still described as a work in progress, centers on a staged handover of weapons rather than a one-time surrender.
segments.tr: Le plan, toujours décrit comme un travail en cours, est centré sur un transfert progressif des armes plutôt que sur une reddition unique.

segments.src: Under the proposed mechanism:
segments.tr: Selon le mécanisme proposé :

segments.src: - Hamas fighters would turn over heavy and mid-tier weapons to a body of Palestinian technocrats — administrators without formal ties to Hamas's military wing.
segments.tr: - Les combattants du Hamas remettraient leurs armes lourdes et de moyenne portée à un organe de technocrates palestiniens — des administrateurs sans liens formels avec la branche militaire du Hamas.

segments.src: - Those technocrats would then transfer the arms to an international stabilization force.
segments.tr: - Ces technocrates transféreraient ensuite les armes à une force internationale de stabilisation.

segments.src: - The process would be overseen and verified by a designated American general, whose role is meant to reassure both Israeli officials and Gaza's population that the handover is being independently monitored.
segments.tr: - Le processus serait supervisé et vérifié par un général américain désigné, dont le rôle est censé rassurer à la fois les responsables israéliens et la population de Gaza quant au fait que le transfert fait l'objet d'un suivi indépendant.

segments.src: Sources briefed on the talks say the design is meant to give Hamas a face-saving off-ramp while giving Israel and international partners a verifiable chain of custody for the weapons — addressing a core sticking point that has stalled previous ceasefire and disarmament proposals.
segments.tr: Des sources informées des discussions affirment que la conception vise à offrir au Hamas une issue honorable tout en donnant à Israël et aux partenaires internationaux une chaîne de contrôle vérifiable pour les armes — répondant ainsi à un point de friction central qui a bloqué les précédentes propositions de cessez-le-feu et de désarmement.

segments.src: ## Netanyahu's Conditional Backing
segments.tr: ## Le soutien conditionnel de Netanyahu

segments.src: Reports indicate Netanyahu has signaled support for the handover mechanism itself, viewing third-party verification and an American military figure's involvement as a credible safeguard.
segments.tr: Des rapports indiquent que Netanyahu a signalé son soutien au mécanisme de transfert lui-même, considérant la vérification par un tiers et l'implication d'une figure militaire américaine comme une garantie crédible.

segments.src: However, he is said to be maintaining a firm position on troop posture: Israeli forces would not withdraw from their current positions in Gaza until disarmament is confirmed as complete, not merely underway.
segments.tr: Cependant, il maintiendrait une position ferme sur la posture des troupes : les forces israéliennes ne se retireraient pas de leurs positions actuelles à Gaza tant que le désarmement ne sera pas confirmé comme étant complet, et non simplement en cours.

segments.src: That stance has left open questions about sequencing.
segments.tr: Cette position laisse en suspens des questions sur le calendrier.

segments.src: Officials involved in the talks reportedly acknowledge that tying full withdrawal to full disarmament could stretch the timeline considerably, since verifying that Hamas has surrendered its entire arsenal — rather than a portion of it — is logistically difficult in a territory where weapons caches are dispersed and often hidden.
segments.tr: Des responsables impliqués dans les négociations reconnaîtraient que lier le retrait total au désarmement total pourrait considérablement étirer le calendrier, étant donné qu'il est logistiquement difficile de vérifier que le Hamas a abandonné l'intégralité de son arsenal — et non seulement une partie — dans un territoire où les caches d'armes sont dispersées et souvent cachées.

segments.src: ## Reconstruction and Governance Left Waiting
segments.tr: ## La reconstruction et la gouvernance laissées en attente

segments.src: The disagreement over timing has broader consequences.
segments.tr: Le désaccord sur le calendrier a des conséquences plus larges.

segments.src: Plans for rebuilding Gaza's shattered infrastructure and establishing a postwar governing authority reportedly remain on hold pending clarity on the security track.
segments.tr: Les plans visant à reconstruire les infrastructures brisées de Gaza et à établir une autorité de gouvernance d'après-guerre resteraient en suspens dans l'attente de clarifications sur le volet sécuritaire.

segments.src: International donors and agencies said to be involved in reconstruction planning are described as reluctant to commit resources without a clearer picture of who will govern Gaza and under what security guarantees.
segments.tr: Les donateurs internationaux et les agences impliqués dans la planification de la reconstruction seraient réticents à engager des ressources sans une vision plus claire de qui gouvernera Gaza et sous quelles garanties de sécurité.

segments.src: Analysts who have followed the negotiations note that this is not the first attempt to separate Hamas's political function from its military capability, but the addition of a named American oversight figure and a Palestinian technocratic intermediary is being described as a notable shift from earlier proposals that relied more heavily on Israeli or purely international enforcement.
segments.tr: Les analystes qui ont suivi les négociations notent qu'il ne s'agit pas de la première tentative de séparer la fonction politique du Hamas de sa capacité militaire, mais l'ajout d'une figure de surveillance américaine nommée et d'un intermédiaire technocratique palestinien est décrit comme un changement notable par rapport aux propositions antérieures qui reposaient plus fortement sur une application israélienne ou purement internationale.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Prochaines étapes

segments.src: People close to the process caution that no timeline has been finalized and that both the composition of the international force and the identity of the American general remain under discussion.
segments.tr: Des personnes proches du processus avertissent qu'aucun calendrier n'a été finalisé et que tant la composition de la force internationale que l'identité du général américain restent en discussion.

segments.src: Kushner is expected to continue shuttling between regional capitals in the coming weeks as mediators try to convert the framework into a formal agreement.
segments.tr: Kushner devrait continuer à faire des navettes entre les capitales régionales dans les semaines à venir alors que les médiateurs tentent de convertir le cadre en un accord formel.

segments.src: For now, the plan represents a potential bridge between two positions that have long seemed incompatible: Hamas's reluctance to disarm without guarantees, and Israel's insistence on verified disarmament before any troop drawdown.
segments.tr: Pour l'instant, le plan représente un pont potentiel entre deux positions qui ont longtemps semblé incompatibles : la réticence du Hamas à se désarmer sans garanties, et l'insistance d'Israël sur un désarmement vérifié avant tout retrait de troupes.

segments.src: Whether that bridge holds may determine how quickly Gaza's reconstruction — and its political future — can move forward.
segments.tr: La tenue de ce pont pourrait déterminer la rapidité avec laquelle la reconstruction de Gaza — et son avenir politique — pourront progresser.

segments.src: *This article is based on reporting from officials and people familiar with the ongoing negotiations.
segments.tr: *Cet article est basé sur des reportages auprès de responsables et de personnes familières avec les négociations en cours.

segments.src: Details of the plan may change as talks continue.*
segments.tr: Les détails du plan sont susceptibles de changer au fur et à mesure que les pourparlers se poursuivent.*

pt.title: Um General, Uma Transferência: Por Dentro do Plano de Kushner para Fazer o Hamas se Desarmar

segments.src: ## A New Road Map Takes Shape
segments.tr: ## Um Novo Roteiro Toma Forma

segments.src: According to people familiar with the discussions, senior White House adviser Jared Kushner recently held a rare face-to-face meeting with Hamas representatives in Egypt before traveling directly to Jerusalem to brief Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on a revised framework for ending the group's role as an armed force in Gaza.
segments.tr: De acordo com pessoas familiarizadas com as discussões, o conselheiro sênior da Casa Blanca, Jared Kushner, realizou recentemente uma reunião presencial rara com representantes do Hamas no Egito antes de viajar diretamente para Jerusalém para informar o primeiro-ministro israelense, Benjamin Netanyahu, sobre uma estrutura revisada para encerrar o papel do grupo como força armada em Gaza.

segments.src: The plan, still described as a work in progress, centers on a staged handover of weapons rather than a one-time surrender.
segments.tr: O plano, ainda descrito como um trabalho em andamento, centra-se em uma entrega gradual de armas em vez de uma rendição única.

segments.src: Under the proposed mechanism:
segments.tr: Sob o mecanismo proposto:

segments.src: - Hamas fighters would turn over heavy and mid-tier weapons to a body of Palestinian technocrats — administrators without formal ties to Hamas's military wing.
segments.tr: - Os combatentes do Hamas entregariam armas pesadas e de médio porte a um órgão de tecnocratas palestinos — administradores sem laços formais com a ala militar do Hamas.

segments.src: - Those technocrats would then transfer the arms to an international stabilization force.
segments.tr: - Esses tecnocratas então transfeririam as armas para uma força internacional de estabilização.

segments.src: - The process would be overseen and verified by a designated American general, whose role is meant to reassure both Israeli officials and Gaza's population that the handover is being independently monitored.
segments.tr: - O processo seria supervisionado e verificado por um general americano designado, cujo papel visa tranquilizar tanto as autoridades israelenses quanto a população de Gaza de que a entrega está sendo monitorada de forma independente.

segments.src: Sources briefed on the talks say the design is meant to give Hamas a face-saving off-ramp while giving Israel and international partners a verifiable chain of custody for the weapons — addressing a core sticking point that has stalled previous ceasefire and disarmament proposals.
segments.tr: Fontes informadas sobre as negociações dizem que o projeto visa dar ao Hamas uma saída honrosa, ao mesmo tempo em que oferece a Israel e aos parceiros internacionais uma cadeia de custódia verificável para as armas — abordando um ponto central de discórdia que paralisou propostas anteriores de cessar-fogo e desarmamento.

segments.src: ## Netanyahu's Conditional Backing
segments.tr: ## O Apoio Condicional de Netanyahu

segments.src: Reports indicate Netanyahu has signaled support for the handover mechanism itself, viewing third-party verification and an American military figure's involvement as a credible safeguard.
segments.tr: Relatórios indicam que Netanyahu sinalizou apoio ao mecanismo de entrega em si, vendo a verificação de terceiros e o envolvimento de uma figura militar americana como uma salvaguarda credível.

segments.src: However, he is said to be maintaining a firm position on troop posture: Israeli forces would not withdraw from their current positions in Gaza until disarmament is confirmed as complete, not merely underway.
segments.tr: No entanto, diz-se que ele mantém uma posição firme sobre a postura das tropas: as forças israelenses não se retirariam de suas posições atuais em Gaza até que o desarmamento seja confirmado como completo, e não apenas em andamento.

segments.src: That stance has left open questions about sequencing.
segments.tr: Essa postura deixou em aberto questões sobre a sequência.

segments.src: Officials involved in the talks reportedly acknowledge that tying full withdrawal to full disarmament could stretch the timeline considerably, since verifying that Hamas has surrendered its entire arsenal — rather than a portion of it — is logistically difficult in a territory where weapons caches are dispersed and often hidden.
segments.tr: Autoridades envolvidas nas negociações supostamente reconhecem que vincular a retirada total ao desarmamento total pode estender consideravelmente o cronograma, uma vez que verificar se o Hamas entregou todo o seu arsenal — em vez de uma parte dele — é logisticamente difícil em um território onde os esconderijos de armas estão dispersos e frequentemente ocultos.

segments.src: ## Reconstruction and Governance Left Waiting
segments.tr: ## Reconstrução e Governança Deixadas em Espera

segments.src: The disagreement over timing has broader consequences.
segments.tr: A divergência sobre o timing tem consequências mais amplas.

segments.src: Plans for rebuilding Gaza's shattered infrastructure and establishing a postwar governing authority reportedly remain on hold pending clarity on the security track.
segments.tr: Os planos para reconstruir a infraestrutura destruída de Gaza e estabelecer uma autoridade governamental pós-guerra permanecem supostamente em espera, aguardando clareza sobre a vertente de segurança.

segments.src: International donors and agencies said to be involved in reconstruction planning are described as reluctant to commit resources without a clearer picture of who will govern Gaza and under what security guarantees.
segments.tr: Doadores e agências internacionais que estariam envolvidos no planejamento da reconstrução são descritos como relutantes em comprometer recursos sem uma imagem mais clara de quem governará Gaza e sob quais garantias de segurança.

segments.src: Analysts who have followed the negotiations note that this is not the first attempt to separate Hamas's political function from its military capability, but the addition of a named American oversight figure and a Palestinian technocratic intermediary is being described as a notable shift from earlier proposals that relied more heavily on Israeli or purely international enforcement.
segments.tr: Analistas que acompanham as negociações observam que esta não é a primeira tentativa de separar a função política do Hamas de sua capacidade militar, mas a adição de uma figura de supervisão americana nomeada e de um intermediário tecnocrático palestino está sendo descrita como uma mudança notável em relação a propostas anteriores que dependiam mais fortemente de imposição israelense ou puramente internacional.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## O Que Acontece a Seguir

segments.src: People close to the process caution that no timeline has been finalized and that both the composition of the international force and the identity of the American general remain under discussion.
segments.tr: Pessoas próximas ao processo alertam que nenhum cronograma foi finalizado e que tanto a composição da força internacional quanto a identidade do general americano continuam sob discussão.

segments.src: Kushner is expected to continue shuttling between regional capitals in the coming weeks as mediators try to convert the framework into a formal agreement.
segments.tr: Espera-se que Kushner continue fazendo viagens entre as capitais regionais nas próximas semanas, enquanto os mediadores tentam converter a estrutura em um acordo formal.

segments.src: For now, the plan represents a potential bridge between two positions that have long seemed incompatible: Hamas's reluctance to disarm without guarantees, and Israel's insistence on verified disarmament before any troop drawdown.
segments.tr: Por enquanto, o plano representa uma ponte potencial entre duas posições que há muito pareciam incompatíveis: a relutância do Hamas em se desarmar sem garantias e a insistência de Israel em um desarmamento verificado antes de qualquer redução de tropas.

segments.src: Whether that bridge holds may determine how quickly Gaza's reconstruction — and its political future — can move forward.
segments.tr: Se essa ponte vai se sustentar pode determinar com que rapidez a reconstrução de Gaza — e seu futuro político — poderá avançar.

segments.tr: Os detalhes do plano podem mudar à medida que as conversas continuam.*

in.title: Satu Jenderal, Satu Penyerahan: Di Balik Rencana Kushner untuk Melucuti Senjata Hamas

segments.src: ## A New Road Map Takes Shape
segments.tr: ## Peta Jalan Baru Mulai Terbentuk

segments.src: According to people familiar with the discussions, senior White House adviser Jared Kushner recently held a rare face-to-face meeting with Hamas representatives in Egypt before traveling directly to Jerusalem to brief Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on a revised framework for ending the group's role as an armed force in Gaza.
segments.tr: Menurut orang-orang yang mengetahui diskusi tersebut, penasihat senior Gedung Putih Jared Kushner baru-baru ini mengadakan pertemuan tatap muka yang jarang terjadi dengan perwakilan Hamas di Mesir sebelum langsung terbang ke Yerusalem untuk memberi pengarahan kepada Perdana Menteri Israel Benjamin Netanyahu mengenai kerangka kerja yang direvisi untuk mengakhiri peran kelompok tersebut sebagai kekuatan bersenjata di Gaza.

segments.src: The plan, still described as a work in progress, centers on a staged handover of weapons rather than a one-time surrender.
segments.tr: Rencana tersebut, yang masih digambarkan sebagai upaya yang sedang berjalan, berpusat pada penyerahan senjata secara bertahap, bukan penyerahan satu kali.

segments.src: Under the proposed mechanism:
segments.tr: Di bawah mekanisme yang diusulkan:

segments.src: - Hamas fighters would turn over heavy and mid-tier weapons to a body of Palestinian technocrats — administrators without formal ties to Hamas's military wing.
segments.tr: - Pejuang Hamas akan menyerahkan senjata berat dan menengah kepada badan teknokrat Palestina — administrator tanpa hubungan formal dengan sayap militer Hamas.

segments.src: - Those technocrats would then transfer the arms to an international stabilization force.
segments.tr: - Para teknokrat tersebut kemudian akan mentransfer senjata itu ke pasukan stabilisasi internasional.

segments.src: - The process would be overseen and verified by a designated American general, whose role is meant to reassure both Israeli officials and Gaza's population that the handover is being independently monitored.
segments.tr: - Proses tersebut akan diawasi dan diverifikasi oleh seorang jenderal Amerika yang ditunjuk, yang perannya dimaksudkan untuk meyakinkan pejabat Israel maupun penduduk Gaza bahwa penyerahan tersebut dipantau secara independen.

segments.src: Sources briefed on the talks say the design is meant to give Hamas a face-saving off-ramp while giving Israel and international partners a verifiable chain of custody for the weapons — addressing a core sticking point that has stalled previous ceasefire and disarmament proposals.
segments.tr: Sumber-sumber yang diberi pengarahan tentang pembicaraan tersebut mengatakan bahwa rancangan ini dimaksudkan untuk memberikan jalan keluar yang menyelamatkan muka bagi Hamas sekaligus memberikan rantai pengawasan senjata yang dapat diverifikasi kepada Israel dan mitra internasional — mengatasi poin utama yang telah menghambat proposal gencatan senjata dan pelucutan senjata sebelumnya.

segments.src: ## Netanyahu's Conditional Backing
segments.tr: ## Dukungan Bersyarat Netanyahu

segments.src: Reports indicate Netanyahu has signaled support for the handover mechanism itself, viewing third-party verification and an American military figure's involvement as a credible safeguard.
segments.tr: Laporan menunjukkan Netanyahu telah memberi sinyal dukungan untuk mekanisme penyerahan itu sendiri, memandang verifikasi pihak ketiga dan keterlibatan tokoh militer Amerika sebagai perlindungan yang kredibel.

segments.src: However, he is said to be maintaining a firm position on troop posture: Israeli forces would not withdraw from their current positions in Gaza until disarmament is confirmed as complete, not merely underway.
segments.tr: Namun, ia dikatakan tetap mempertahankan posisi tegas mengenai postur pasukan: Pasukan Israel tidak akan menarik diri dari posisi mereka saat ini di Gaza sampai pelucutan senjata dikonfirmasi selesai, bukan sekadar sedang berlangsung.

segments.src: That stance has left open questions about sequencing.
segments.tr: Sikap itu menyisakan pertanyaan terbuka tentang urutan.

segments.src: Officials involved in the talks reportedly acknowledge that tying full withdrawal to full disarmament could stretch the timeline considerably, since verifying that Hamas has surrendered its entire arsenal — rather than a portion of it — is logistically difficult in a territory where weapons caches are dispersed and often hidden.
segments.tr: Para pejabat yang terlibat dalam pembicaraan dilaporkan mengakui bahwa mengaitkan penarikan penuh dengan pelucutan senjata penuh dapat memperpanjang jadwal secara signifikan, karena memverifikasi bahwa Hamas telah menyerahkan seluruh persenjataannya — bukan hanya sebagian — secara logistik sulit dilakukan di wilayah di mana tempat penyimpanan senjata tersebar dan sering kali tersembunyi.

segments.src: ## Reconstruction and Governance Left Waiting
segments.tr: ## Rekonstruksi dan Tata Kelola Menunggu

segments.src: The disagreement over timing has broader consequences.
segments.tr: Ketidaksepakatan mengenai waktu memiliki konsekuensi yang lebih luas.

segments.src: Plans for rebuilding Gaza's shattered infrastructure and establishing a postwar governing authority reportedly remain on hold pending clarity on the security track.
segments.tr: Rencana untuk membangun kembali infrastruktur Gaza yang hancur dan membentuk otoritas pemerintahan pascaperang dilaporkan tetap ditunda sambil menunggu kejelasan pada jalur keamanan.

segments.src: International donors and agencies said to be involved in reconstruction planning are described as reluctant to commit resources without a clearer picture of who will govern Gaza and under what security guarantees.
segments.tr: Donor dan badan internasional yang dikatakan terlibat dalam perencanaan rekonstruksi digambarkan enggan untuk berkomitmen memberikan sumber daya tanpa gambaran yang lebih jelas tentang siapa yang akan memerintah Gaza dan di bawah jaminan keamanan apa.

segments.src: Analysts who have followed the negotiations note that this is not the first attempt to separate Hamas's political function from its military capability, but the addition of a named American oversight figure and a Palestinian technocratic intermediary is being described as a notable shift from earlier proposals that relied more heavily on Israeli or purely international enforcement.
segments.tr: Analis yang mengikuti negosiasi mencatat bahwa ini bukan upaya pertama untuk memisahkan fungsi politik Hamas dari kemampuan militernya, tetapi penambahan tokoh pengawas Amerika yang disebutkan namanya dan perantara teknokrat Palestina digambarkan sebagai perubahan penting dari proposal sebelumnya yang lebih mengandalkan penegakan hukum Israel atau murni internasional.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Apa Selanjutnya

segments.src: People close to the process caution that no timeline has been finalized and that both the composition of the international force and the identity of the American general remain under discussion.
segments.tr: Orang-orang yang dekat dengan proses tersebut memperingatkan bahwa belum ada jadwal yang diselesaikan dan bahwa komposisi pasukan internasional maupun identitas jenderal Amerika tersebut masih dalam pembahasan.

segments.src: Kushner is expected to continue shuttling between regional capitals in the coming weeks as mediators try to convert the framework into a formal agreement.
segments.tr: Kushner diperkirakan akan terus melakukan perjalanan antar ibu kota regional dalam beberapa minggu mendatang saat para mediator mencoba mengubah kerangka kerja tersebut menjadi perjanjian formal.

segments.src: For now, the plan represents a potential bridge between two positions that have long seemed incompatible: Hamas's reluctance to disarm without guarantees, and Israel's insistence on verified disarmament before any troop drawdown.
segments.tr: Untuk saat ini, rencana tersebut mewakili jembatan potensial antara dua posisi yang telah lama tampak tidak kompatibel: keengganan Hamas untuk melucuti senjata tanpa jaminan, dan desakan Israel untuk pelucutan senjata yang diverifikasi sebelum penarikan pasukan apa pun.

segments.src: Whether that bridge holds may determine how quickly Gaza's reconstruction — and its political future — can move forward.
segments.tr: Apakah jembatan itu bertahan mungkin menentukan seberapa cepat rekonstruksi Gaza — dan masa depan politiknya — dapat bergerak maju.

segments.tr: *Artikel ini didasarkan pada laporan dari para pejabat dan orang-orang yang mengetahui negosiasi yang sedang berlangsung.

ja.title: 将軍1人と引き渡し：ハマスを武装解除させるクシュナー氏の計画の内幕

segments.src: ## A New Road Map Takes Shape
segments.tr: ## 新たなロードマップの具体化

segments.src: According to people familiar with the discussions, senior White House adviser Jared Kushner recently held a rare face-to-face meeting with Hamas representatives in Egypt before traveling directly to Jerusalem to brief Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on a revised framework for ending the group's role as an armed force in Gaza.
segments.tr: 協議に詳しい関係者によると、ホワイトハウス上級顧問のジャレッド・クシュナー氏は先日、エジプトでハマス代表者との異例の直接会談を行い、その後すぐにエルサレムへ移動して、ガザにおける同組織の武装勢力としての役割を終わらせるための修正枠組みについて、イスラエルのベンヤミン・ネタニヤフ首相に説明を行いました。

segments.src: The plan, still described as a work in progress, centers on a staged handover of weapons rather than a one-time surrender.
segments.tr: 現在も進行中の案とされているこの計画は、一括した降伏ではなく、段階的な武器の引き渡しを中心に据えています。

segments.src: Under the proposed mechanism:
segments.tr: 提案されているメカニズムは以下の通りです：

segments.src: - Hamas fighters would turn over heavy and mid-tier weapons to a body of Palestinian technocrats — administrators without formal ties to Hamas's military wing.
segments.tr: - ハマスの戦闘員は、重兵器および中級兵器を、ハマスの軍事部門と公式なつながりのない実務家（テクノクラート）で構成されるパレスチナの機関に引き渡す。

segments.src: - Those technocrats would then transfer the arms to an international stabilization force.
segments.tr: - その後、実務家たちがそれらの武器を国際安定化部隊に移譲する。

segments.src: - The process would be overseen and verified by a designated American general, whose role is meant to reassure both Israeli officials and Gaza's population that the handover is being independently monitored.
segments.tr: - このプロセスは、指名されたアメリカの将軍によって監督・検証される。この将軍の役割は、引き渡しが独立して監視されていることをイスラエル当局とガザの住民の双方に保証することである。

segments.src: Sources briefed on the talks say the design is meant to give Hamas a face-saving off-ramp while giving Israel and international partners a verifiable chain of custody for the weapons — addressing a core sticking point that has stalled previous ceasefire and disarmament proposals.
segments.tr: 協議の報告を受けた情報筋によると、この設計はハマスに面目を保てる出口戦略（オフランプ）を提供する一方で、イスラエルと国際的なパートナーには検証可能な武器の管理チェーンを提供することを目的としており、これまでの停戦や武装解除の提案を停滞させてきた核心的な対立点に対処するものです。

segments.src: ## Netanyahu's Conditional Backing
segments.tr: ## ネタニヤフ首相の条件付き支持

segments.src: Reports indicate Netanyahu has signaled support for the handover mechanism itself, viewing third-party verification and an American military figure's involvement as a credible safeguard.
segments.tr: 報道によると、ネタニヤフ首相はこの引き渡しメカニズム自体への支持を示しており、第三者による検証とアメリカ軍関係者の関与を信頼できる安全策と見なしているとのことです。

segments.src: However, he is said to be maintaining a firm position on troop posture: Israeli forces would not withdraw from their current positions in Gaza until disarmament is confirmed as complete, not merely underway.
segments.tr: しかし、同首相は部隊の配置について強硬な姿勢を崩していないとされています。すなわち、武装解除が単に進行中であるだけでなく、完了したと確認されるまでは、イスラエル軍はガザの現在の陣地から撤退しないという方針です。

segments.src: That stance has left open questions about sequencing.
segments.tr: この姿勢により、順序（シーケンシング）に関する疑問が残されています。

segments.src: Officials involved in the talks reportedly acknowledge that tying full withdrawal to full disarmament could stretch the timeline considerably, since verifying that Hamas has surrendered its entire arsenal — rather than a portion of it — is logistically difficult in a territory where weapons caches are dispersed and often hidden.
segments.tr: 協議に関与している当局者らは、完全な撤退を完全な武装解除と結びつけることは、スケジュールを大幅に引き延ばす可能性があることを認めていると報じられています。なぜなら、武器の隠し場所が分散し、しばしば隠されている地域において、ハマスが兵器の一部ではなく「すべて」を放棄したことを検証することは、ロジスティクス的に極めて困難だからです。

segments.src: ## Reconstruction and Governance Left Waiting
segments.tr: ## 復興と統治は棚上げに

segments.src: The disagreement over timing has broader consequences.
segments.tr: タイミングをめぐる不一致は、より広範な影響を及ぼしています。

segments.src: Plans for rebuilding Gaza's shattered infrastructure and establishing a postwar governing authority reportedly remain on hold pending clarity on the security track.
segments.tr: 破壊されたガザのインフラ再建や戦後の統治機関の設立に関する計画は、安全保障面での進展が明確になるまで保留されたままであると報じられています。

segments.src: International donors and agencies said to be involved in reconstruction planning are described as reluctant to commit resources without a clearer picture of who will govern Gaza and under what security guarantees.
segments.tr: 復興計画に関与しているとされる国際的なドナーや機関は、誰がどのような安全保障のもとでガザを統治するのかという明確な見通しが立たない限り、資金や資源を投入することに消極的であると伝えられています。

segments.src: Analysts who have followed the negotiations note that this is not the first attempt to separate Hamas's political function from its military capability, but the addition of a named American oversight figure and a Palestinian technocratic intermediary is being described as a notable shift from earlier proposals that relied more heavily on Israeli or purely international enforcement.
segments.tr: 交渉を追ってきたアナリストらは、ハマスの政治的機能と軍事的能力を分離しようとする試みはこれが初めてではないと指摘しつつも、指名されたアメリカの監視役とパレスチナの実務家仲介者を加えたことは、イスラエルや純粋に国際的な強制力に大きく依存していたこれまでの提案からの顕著な転換であると述べています。

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 今後の展望

segments.src: People close to the process caution that no timeline has been finalized and that both the composition of the international force and the identity of the American general remain under discussion.
segments.tr: プロセスに近い関係者らは、スケジュールはまだ確定しておらず、国際部隊の構成やアメリカの将軍の身元についても協議が続いていると注意を促しています。

segments.src: Kushner is expected to continue shuttling between regional capitals in the coming weeks as mediators try to convert the framework into a formal agreement.
segments.tr: クシュナー氏は、仲介者たちがこの枠組みを正式な合意へと移行させようとする中、今後数週間にわたり地域の首都間を往復し続ける見込みです。

segments.src: For now, the plan represents a potential bridge between two positions that have long seemed incompatible: Hamas's reluctance to disarm without guarantees, and Israel's insistence on verified disarmament before any troop drawdown.
segments.tr: 現時点でこの計画は、長らく相容れないと思われてきた2つの立場の架け橋となる可能性を秘めています。それは、保証なしでの武装解除を嫌うハマスの姿勢と、部隊を縮小する前に検証された武装解除を強く求めるイスラエルの主張です。

segments.src: Whether that bridge holds may determine how quickly Gaza's reconstruction — and its political future — can move forward.
segments.tr: その架け橋が維持されるかどうかが、ガザの復興、そしてその政治的未来がどれだけ迅速に進展するかを左右することになるかもしれません。

segments.src: *This article is based on reporting from officials and people familiar with the ongoing negotiations.
segments.tr: *この記事は、進行中の交渉に詳しい当局者および関係者からの情報に基づいています。

segments.src: Details of the plan may change as talks continue.*
segments.tr: 協議の進展に伴い、計画の詳細は変更される可能性があります。*

de.title: Ein General, eine Übergabe: Hinter den Kulissen von Kushners Plan zur Entwaffnung der Hamas

segments.src: ## A New Road Map Takes Shape
segments.tr: ## Ein neuer Fahrplan zeichnet sich ab

segments.src: According to people familiar with the discussions, senior White House adviser Jared Kushner recently held a rare face-to-face meeting with Hamas representatives in Egypt before traveling directly to Jerusalem to brief Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on a revised framework for ending the group's role as an armed force in Gaza.
segments.tr: Laut mit den Gesprächen vertrauten Personen hielt der hochrangige Berater des Weißen Hauses, Jared Kushner, kürzlich ein seltenes persönliches Treffen mit Hamas-Vertretern in Ägypten ab, bevor er direkt nach Jerusalem reiste, um den israelischen Premierminister Benjamin Netanjahu über einen überarbeiteten Rahmen zur Beendigung der Rolle der Gruppe als bewaffnete Kraft im Gazastreifen zu informieren.

segments.src: The plan, still described as a work in progress, centers on a staged handover of weapons rather than a one-time surrender.
segments.tr: Der Plan, der nach wie vor als Entwurf bezeichnet wird, konzentriert sich auf eine schrittweise Waffenübergabe anstelle einer einmaligen Kapitulation.

segments.src: Under the proposed mechanism:
segments.tr: Dem vorgeschlagenen Mechanismus zufolge:

segments.src: - Hamas fighters would turn over heavy and mid-tier weapons to a body of Palestinian technocrats — administrators without formal ties to Hamas's military wing.
segments.tr: - Kämpfer der Hamas würden schwere und mittelschwere Waffen an ein Gremium palästinensischer Technokraten übergeben — Administratoren ohne formelle Verbindungen zum militärischen Flügel der Hamas.

segments.src: - Those technocrats would then transfer the arms to an international stabilization force.
segments.tr: - Diese Technokraten würden die Waffen dann an eine internationale Stabilisierungstruppe übertragen.

segments.src: - The process would be overseen and verified by a designated American general, whose role is meant to reassure both Israeli officials and Gaza's population that the handover is being independently monitored.
segments.tr: - Der Prozess würde von einem ernannten amerikanischen General beaufsichtigt und verifiziert, dessen Rolle sicherstellen soll, dass sowohl israelische Offizielle als auch die Bevölkerung des Gazastreifens darauf vertrauen können, dass die Übergabe unabhängig überwacht wird.

segments.src: Sources briefed on the talks say the design is meant to give Hamas a face-saving off-ramp while giving Israel and international partners a verifiable chain of custody for the weapons — addressing a core sticking point that has stalled previous ceasefire and disarmament proposals.
segments.tr: Aus den Gesprächen unterrichtete Quellen besagen, dass das Konzept darauf abzielt, der Hamas einen gesichtswahrenden Ausweg zu bieten und gleichzeitig Israel und internationalen Partnern eine überprüfbare Kette der Verantwortlichkeit für die Waffen zu garantieren — womit ein zentraler Streitpunkt angegangen wird, der vorherige Waffenstillstands- und Entwaffnungsvorschläge blockiert hatte.

segments.src: ## Netanyahu's Conditional Backing
segments.tr: ## Netanjahus bedingte Unterstützung

segments.src: Reports indicate Netanyahu has signaled support for the handover mechanism itself, viewing third-party verification and an American military figure's involvement as a credible safeguard.
segments.tr: Berichten zufolge hat Netanjahu seine Unterstützung für den Übergabemechanismus selbst signalisiert, da er die Verifizierung durch Dritte und die Beteiligung einer amerikanischen Militärperson als glaubwürdige Sicherheitsvorkehrung ansieht.

segments.src: However, he is said to be maintaining a firm position on troop posture: Israeli forces would not withdraw from their current positions in Gaza until disarmament is confirmed as complete, not merely underway.
segments.tr: Es heißt jedoch, er behalte eine feste Position bezüglich der Truppenpräsenz bei: Israelische Streitkräfte würden ihre aktuellen Positionen im Gazastreifen erst dann räumen, wenn die Entwaffnung als vollständig und nicht nur als im Gange befindlich bestätigt ist.

segments.src: That stance has left open questions about sequencing.
segments.tr: Diese Haltung wirft offene Fragen hinsichtlich der Abfolge auf.

segments.src: Officials involved in the talks reportedly acknowledge that tying full withdrawal to full disarmament could stretch the timeline considerably, since verifying that Hamas has surrendered its entire arsenal — rather than a portion of it — is logistically difficult in a territory where weapons caches are dispersed and often hidden.
segments.tr: An den Gesprächen beteiligte Offizielle räumen Berichten zufolge ein, dass die Verknüpfung des vollständigen Abzugs mit der vollständigen Entwaffnung den Zeitplan erheblich dehnen könnte, da die Verifizierung, dass die Hamas ihr gesamtes Arsenal — und nicht nur einen Teil davon — aufgegeben hat, in einem Gebiet, in dem Waffenverstecke verstreut und oft verborgen sind, logistisch schwierig ist.

segments.src: ## Reconstruction and Governance Left Waiting
segments.tr: ## Wiederaufbau und Regierungsführung müssen warten

segments.src: The disagreement over timing has broader consequences.
segments.tr: Die Meinungsverschiedenheit über den Zeitplan hat weitreichendere Folgen.

segments.src: Plans for rebuilding Gaza's shattered infrastructure and establishing a postwar governing authority reportedly remain on hold pending clarity on the security track.
segments.tr: Pläne für den Wiederaufbau der zerstörten Infrastruktur des Gazastreifens und die Einsetzung einer Nachkriegsverwaltung bleiben Berichten zufolge so lange ausgesetzt, bis Klarheit über den Sicherheitsweg herrscht.

segments.src: International donors and agencies said to be involved in reconstruction planning are described as reluctant to commit resources without a clearer picture of who will govern Gaza and under what security guarantees.
segments.tr: Internationale Geber und Agenturen, die angeblich in die Planung des Wiederaufbaus involviert sind, zögern dem Vernehmen nach, Ressourcen zuzusagen, solange es kein klareres Bild darüber gibt, wer den Gazastreifen regieren wird und unter welchen Sicherheitsgarantien.

segments.src: Analysts who have followed the negotiations note that this is not the first attempt to separate Hamas's political function from its military capability, but the addition of a named American oversight figure and a Palestinian technocratic intermediary is being described as a notable shift from earlier proposals that relied more heavily on Israeli or purely international enforcement.
segments.tr: Analysten, die die Verhandlungen verfolgt haben, merken an, dass dies nicht der erste Versuch ist, die politische Funktion der Hamas von ihrer militärischen Kapazität zu trennen, aber das Hinzufügen einer namentlich genannten amerikanischen Aufsichtsperson und eines palästinensischen technokratischen Vermittlers wird als bemerkenswerte Veränderung gegenüber früheren Vorschlägen beschrieben, die sich stärker auf israelische oder rein internationale Durchsetzung stützten.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Wie es weitergeht

segments.src: People close to the process caution that no timeline has been finalized and that both the composition of the international force and the identity of the American general remain under discussion.
segments.tr: Personen aus dem Umfeld des Prozesses warnen, dass noch kein Zeitplan finalisiert wurde und sowohl die Zusammensetzung der internationalen Truppe als auch die Identität des amerikanischen Generals weiterhin diskutiert werden.

segments.src: Kushner is expected to continue shuttling between regional capitals in the coming weeks as mediators try to convert the framework into a formal agreement.
segments.tr: Kushner wird voraussichtlich in den kommenden Wochen weiterhin zwischen den regionalen Hauptstädten pendeln, während Mediatoren versuchen, den Rahmen in ein formelles Abkommen zu gießen.

segments.src: For now, the plan represents a potential bridge between two positions that have long seemed incompatible: Hamas's reluctance to disarm without guarantees, and Israel's insistence on verified disarmament before any troop drawdown.
segments.tr: Im Moment stellt der Plan eine potenzielle Brücke zwischen zwei Positionen dar, die lange Zeit unvereinbar schienen: dem Zögern der Hamas, sich ohne Garantien zu entwaffnen, und dem Bestehen Israels auf einer verifizierten Entwaffnung vor jedem Truppenabzug.

segments.src: Whether that bridge holds may determine how quickly Gaza's reconstruction — and its political future — can move forward.
segments.tr: Ob diese Brücke hält, könnte darüber entscheiden, wie schnell der Wiederaufbau des Gazastreifens — und dessen politische Zukunft — vorankommen können.

vi.title: Một Tướng, Một Lần Bàn Giao: Bên Trong Kế Hoạch của Kushner Nhằm Giải Giáp Vũ Khí Hamas

segments.src: ## A New Road Map Takes Shape
segments.tr: ## Một Lộ Trình Mới Dần Hình Thành

segments.src: According to people familiar with the discussions, senior White House adviser Jared Kushner recently held a rare face-to-face meeting with Hamas representatives in Egypt before traveling directly to Jerusalem to brief Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on a revised framework for ending the group's role as an armed force in Gaza.
segments.tr: Theo những người am hiểu về các cuộc thảo luận, cố vấn cấp cao của Nhà Trắng Jared Kushner gần đây đã có một cuộc gặp trực tiếp hiếm hoi với các đại diện của Hamas tại Ai Cập trước khi bay thẳng đến Jerusalem để báo cáo với Thủ tướng Israel Benjamin Netanyahu về một khuôn khổ sửa đổi nhằm chấm dứt vai trò lực lượng vũ trang của nhóm này ở Gaza.

segments.src: The plan, still described as a work in progress, centers on a staged handover of weapons rather than a one-time surrender.
segments.tr: Kế hoạch này, hiện vẫn được mô tả là đang trong quá trình hoàn thiện, tập trung vào việc bàn giao vũ khí theo từng giai đoạn thay vì đầu hàng một lần duy nhất.

segments.src: Under the proposed mechanism:
segments.tr: Theo cơ chế được đề xuất:

segments.src: - Hamas fighters would turn over heavy and mid-tier weapons to a body of Palestinian technocrats — administrators without formal ties to Hamas's military wing.
segments.tr: - Các chiến binh Hamas sẽ bàn giao vũ khí hạng nặng và hạng trung cho một nhóm các nhà kỹ trị Palestine — những nhà quản lý không có mối liên hệ chính thức với cánh quân sự của Hamas.

segments.src: - Those technocrats would then transfer the arms to an international stabilization force.
segments.tr: - Những nhà kỹ trị đó sau đó sẽ chuyển giao số vũ khí này cho một lực lượng ổn định quốc tế.

segments.src: - The process would be overseen and verified by a designated American general, whose role is meant to reassure both Israeli officials and Gaza's population that the handover is being independently monitored.
segments.tr: - Quá trình này sẽ được giám sát và xác minh bởi một vị tướng Mỹ được chỉ định, người có vai trò trấn an cả các quan chức Israel và người dân Gaza rằng việc bàn giao đang được giám sát một cách độc lập.

segments.src: Sources briefed on the talks say the design is meant to give Hamas a face-saving off-ramp while giving Israel and international partners a verifiable chain of custody for the weapons — addressing a core sticking point that has stalled previous ceasefire and disarmament proposals.
segments.tr: Các nguồn tin được thông báo về các cuộc đàm phán cho biết thiết kế này nhằm mang lại cho Hamas một lối thoát giữ thể diện, đồng thời mang lại cho Israel và các đối tác quốc tế một chuỗi lưu giữ vũ khí có thể xác minh được — giải quyết một điểm nghẽn cốt lõi vốn đã làm trì hoãn các đề xuất ngừng bắn và giải giáp vũ khí trước đây.

segments.src: ## Netanyahu's Conditional Backing
segments.tr: ## Sự Ủng Hộ Có Điều Kiện của Netanyahu

segments.src: Reports indicate Netanyahu has signaled support for the handover mechanism itself, viewing third-party verification and an American military figure's involvement as a credible safeguard.
segments.tr: Các báo cáo chỉ ra rằng Netanyahu đã phát tín hiệu ủng hộ chính cơ chế bàn giao này, coi sự xác minh của bên thứ ba và sự tham gia của một nhân vật quân sự Mỹ là một biện pháp bảo vệ đáng tin cậy.

segments.src: However, he is said to be maintaining a firm position on troop posture: Israeli forces would not withdraw from their current positions in Gaza until disarmament is confirmed as complete, not merely underway.
segments.tr: Tuy nhiên, ông được cho là vẫn giữ lập trường vững chắc về thế bố trí quân sự: Lực lượng Israel sẽ không rút khỏi các vị trí hiện tại của họ ở Gaza cho đến khi việc giải giáp vũ khí được xác nhận là đã hoàn tất, chứ không chỉ đơn thuần là đang tiến hành.

segments.src: That stance has left open questions about sequencing.
segments.tr: Lập trường đó đã để lại những câu hỏi mở về trình tự thực hiện.

segments.src: Officials involved in the talks reportedly acknowledge that tying full withdrawal to full disarmament could stretch the timeline considerably, since verifying that Hamas has surrendered its entire arsenal — rather than a portion of it — is logistically difficult in a territory where weapons caches are dispersed and often hidden.
segments.tr: Các quan chức tham gia vào các cuộc đàm phán được báo cáo là thừa nhận rằng việc gắn việc rút quân hoàn toàn với việc giải giáp vũ khí hoàn toàn có thể kéo dài đáng kể mốc thời gian, vì việc xác minh rằng Hamas đã giao nộp toàn bộ kho vũ khí của mình — thay vì chỉ một phần — là điều khó khăn về mặt hậu cần trong một vùng lãnh thổ nơi các kho vũ khí bị phân tán và thường được cất giấu.

segments.tr: Các nhà tài trợ và các cơ quan quốc tế được cho là có tham gia vào kế hoạch tái thiết được mô tả là ngần ngại cam kết nguồn lực nếu không có một bức tranh rõ ràng hơn về việc ai sẽ quản lý Gaza và dưới những đảm bảo an ninh nào.

segments.src: Analysts who have followed the negotiations note that this is not the first attempt to separate Hamas's political function from its military capability, but the addition of a named American oversight figure and a Palestinian technocratic intermediary is being described as a notable shift from earlier proposals that relied more heavily on Israeli or purely international enforcement.
segments.tr: Các nhà phân tích theo dõi các cuộc đàm phán lưu ý rằng đây không phải là nỗ lực đầu tiên nhằm tách biệt chức năng chính trị của Hamas khỏi năng lực quân sự của tổ chức này, nhưng việc bổ sung một nhân vật giám sát người Mỹ được chỉ định danh tính và một trung gian kỹ trị Palestine đang được mô tả là một sự chuyển dịch đáng chú ý so với các đề xuất trước đây vốn phụ thuộc nhiều hơn vào sự thực thi của Israel hoặc hoàn toàn mang tính quốc tế.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Điều Gì Sẽ Đến Tiếp Theo

segments.src: People close to the process caution that no timeline has been finalized and that both the composition of the international force and the identity of the American general remain under discussion.
segments.tr: Những người thân cận với tiến trình này cảnh báo rằng chưa có mốc thời gian nào được hoàn tất và cả thành phần của lực lượng quốc tế lẫn danh tính của vị tướng Mỹ vẫn đang được thảo luận.

segments.src: Kushner is expected to continue shuttling between regional capitals in the coming weeks as mediators try to convert the framework into a formal agreement.
segments.tr: Kushner dự kiến sẽ tiếp tục di chuyển giữa các thủ đô trong khu vực trong những tuần tới khi các nhà trung gian cố gắng chuyển đổi khuôn khổ này thành một thỏa thuận chính thức.

segments.src: For now, the plan represents a potential bridge between two positions that have long seemed incompatible: Hamas's reluctance to disarm without guarantees, and Israel's insistence on verified disarmament before any troop drawdown.
segments.tr: Hiện tại, kế hoạch này đại diện cho một cầu nối tiềm năng giữa hai lập trường từ lâu dường như không thể dung hòa: sự ngần ngại giải giáp vũ khí của Hamas nếu không có các bảo đảm, và sự khăng khăng của Israel về việc giải giáp vũ khí được xác minh trước khi có bất kỳ sự cắt giảm quân số nào.

segments.src: Whether that bridge holds may determine how quickly Gaza's reconstruction — and its political future — can move forward.
segments.tr: Liệu chiếc cầu nối đó có đứng vững hay không có thể quyết định việc tái thiết Gaza — và tương lai chính trị của khu vực này — có thể tiến triển nhanh chóng đến mức nào.
